strat: Neurolinks at 1, 2 and 3, ranged baits Liquid Hell

sources.label: NAUR - Guide: Stop baiting Liquid Hells on the party!!

steps.title: After Twintania appears
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 5m north of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 13m north of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 8m north-west of the centre.

steps.title: After Plummet resolves
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

RegenHealer.rule: Go to 8m north-west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 5m west of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 3m south-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 3m south-east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Go to 5m east of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Go to 8m north-east of the centre.

steps.title: After a marker lands on you
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 5m north of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 13m north of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 11m north-west of the centre.

steps.title: After Death Sentence hits you
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 5m north of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 8m north-west of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 13m north of the centre.

steps.title: After Slashing Resistance Down II on you
steps.cue: Slashing Resistance Down II on you
steps.rule: Go to 5m west of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 12m west of the centre.

steps.title: After Liquid Hell hits you
steps.rule: Go to the east wall.

steps.title: After a marker lands on you
steps.rule: Stand on waymark 1.

steps.title: After Neurolink on another player
steps.rule: Go to the south wall.

steps.title: After Mana Hypersensitivity on you
steps.rule: Go to 5m west of the centre.

steps.title: After Liquid Hell hits you
steps.rule: Go to 8m south-west of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 13m south-west of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 14m south-west of the centre.

steps.title: After Death Sentence hits you
steps.rule: Go to 14m south-west of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 13m south-west of the centre.

steps.title: After a marker lands on you
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 11m north of the centre.

steps.title: After Neurolink on another player
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

RegenHealer.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 4m west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 3m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Stand near waymark D, 8m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: When HatchTargets leaves out [MeleeDpsA], stand near waymark D, 12m south of the centre; when HatchTargets includes [MeleeDpsA], stand near waymark D, 8m south of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Go to 14m south of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: When HatchTargets leaves out [CasterDps], stand near waymark D, 12m south of the centre; when HatchTargets includes [CasterDps], go to 14m south of the centre.

steps.title: After Neurolink on you
steps.rule: Go to 8m south-west of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 13m west of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: If you are in LiquidHellTarget: Stand on waymark 1; otherwise: Stand near waymark D, 8m south-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: When TwisterTargets includes M2 and FireballTargets leaves out H2, go to 9m south-west of the centre; when TwisterTargets includes M2 and FireballTargets includes H2, stand on waymark 1; when TwisterTargets leaves out M2 and FireballTargets includes H2, go to 9m south-west of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LiquidHellTarget).

CasterDps.rule: When HatchTargets includes PhysRangedDps] and HatchTargets leaves out [PhysRangedDps, stand near waymark D, 8m south-west of the centre; when HatchTargets includes PhysRangedDps] and HatchTargets includes [PhysRangedDps, stand on waymark 1; when HatchTargets leaves out PhysRangedDps] and HatchTargets includes [PhysRangedDps, stand near waymark D, 8m south-west of the centre.

steps.title: After Mana Hypersensitivity on you
steps.rule: Go to 8m south-west of the centre.

steps.title: After Mana Hypersensitivity on you
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 7m south-east of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 14m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: After Liquid Hell hits you
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 7m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: After a marker lands on you
steps.rule: If you are in LiquidHellTarget: Go to the south-east wall; otherwise: Stand near waymark 3, 7m south-east of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: When HatchTargets includes PhysRangedDps] and HatchTargets leaves out [PhysRangedDps, stand on waymark 1; when HatchTargets includes PhysRangedDps] and HatchTargets includes [PhysRangedDps, stand near waymark 3, 8m south-east of the centre; when HatchTargets leaves out PhysRangedDps] and HatchTargets includes [PhysRangedDps, go to the south-east wall.

MeleeDpsB.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LiquidHellTarget).

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LiquidHellTarget).

CasterDps.rule: When FireballTargets leaves out R2 and HatchTargets leaves out [PhysRangedDps, stand near waymark 3, 8m south-east of the centre; when FireballTargets leaves out R2 and HatchTargets includes [PhysRangedDps, stand on waymark 2; when FireballTargets includes R2 and HatchTargets includes [PhysRangedDps, stand near waymark 3, 8m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: After Liquid Hell hits you
steps.rule: Go to the south-east wall.

steps.title: After Liquid Hell resolves
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 7m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: After Death Sentence cast starts
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 7m south-east of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 14m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: After Death Sentence hits you
steps.rule: Go to the south-east wall.

OffTank.rule: Go to 14m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: After a marker lands on you
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 11m north of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Stand near waymark 2, 12m south-west of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: When HatchTargets includes [MeleeDpsA, stand near waymark 2, 12m south-west of the centre; when HatchTargets leaves out [MeleeDpsA, stand near waymark 1, 11m north of the centre.

steps.title: After Neurolink on another player
steps.rule: Go to the north-west wall.

RegenHealer.rule: Go to 13m south-east of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Stand near waymark D, 6m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Go to 5m east of the centre.

steps.title: After Neurolink on you
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 7m south-east of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 14m east of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: When FireballTargets leaves out R2, stand on waymark 1; when FireballTargets includes R2, go to the west wall.

PhysRangedDps.rule: When FireballTargets includes H1 and HatchTargets leaves out [PhysRangedDps, go to the west wall; when FireballTargets leaves out H1 and HatchTargets leaves out [PhysRangedDps, stand on waymark 2; when FireballTargets leaves out H1 and HatchTargets includes [PhysRangedDps, go to the west wall; when FireballTargets includes H1 and HatchTargets includes [PhysRangedDps, stand on waymark 1.

CasterDps.rule: When TwisterTargets includes R2 and HatchTargets includes R2, stand on waymark 2; when TwisterTargets includes R2 and HatchTargets leaves out R2, go to the west wall; when TwisterTargets leaves out R2 and HatchTargets includes R2, go to the west wall.

steps.title: After Mana Hypersensitivity on you
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 7m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: After Liquid Hell hits you
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 7m south-east of the centre.
